reviews.text:
I got this as a gift for my mom, and she really enjoyed using it. She said the patches felt very cooling and comfortable on her skin, and they stayed in place nicely without slipping.
She did notice a slight tightening effect around the jawline right after use, which she liked, especially for a quick self-care moment. Of course, the results aren’t permanent, but it’s a nice little boost and feels quite relaxing.
reviews.zh:
我係買畀我媽媽做禮物，佢好鍾意用。佢話眼膜貼片敷起嚟好清涼、舒服，而且貼得好穩，唔會滑落。
佢用完之後下巴線即時有少少收緊嘅效果，佢好鍾意，尤其係用嚟做一個快速嘅自我護理時刻。當然，效果唔係永久，但係好小小嘅提升，而且感覺相當舒緩。

reviews.text: these jaw masks are perfect feels super smooth and cooling going on not too much tug on your ears so thet dont hurt to leave on like other jaw masks and stops spot picking! feels like a plaster on the outside and soothing gel inside
reviews.zh: 呢款下巴面膜好啱用，感覺好順滑、清涼，唔會好似其他下巴面膜咁扯耳仔，所以戴住都唔會痛，而且仲可以阻止我挑痘！外層似膠布，入面係舒緩嘅啫喱。

reviews.text: I usually do not trust this kind of facial mask can help reducing fat. But I do think they can physically reduce the edema by shaping and tightening skin. The suggested time to use it is 30 minutes but I used it overnight. Put it on before sleep and take off after wake up. It helps a bit but not very obvious visibly. Can try if you have serious edema face but do not expect it helps reducing fat.
reviews.zh: 我通常唔信呢類臉部面膜可以減脂。但我認為佢哋可以通過塑形同收緊皮膚，令水腫物理上減少。建議用嘅時間係 30 分鐘，但係我整晚都用。瞓覺前貼上，醒嚟先撕走。有少少幫助，但視覺上唔係好明顯。如果你面部有嚴重水腫可以試吓，但唔好期望佢可以減脂。

reviews.text: These chin masks are more like skincare infused chin straps. The outside is made from a fabric-like material and the inside has a gel-like consistency. I was a bit confused when I first opened them because they are not like any other mask I have ever used, but they do definitely work.
reviews.zh: 呢啲下巴貼更似加咗護膚成分嘅下巴帶。外層係類似布料嘅物料，入面係啫喱質地。第一次打開嗰陣我有啲困惑，因為佢哋同我用過嘅任何面膜都唔同，但係佢哋確實有效。

reviews.text:
These feel more like tape than a mask tbh. They also strongly pull on your ears, very uncomfortable to wear.
You look silly when wearing it 😂 
But at least it has some ingredients like retinol in it, I just didn’t feel any essence and therefore don’t know it it has any actually benefits
reviews.zh:
老實講，呢啲感覺更似膠布多過面膜。佢哋亦會用力拉扯耳仔，戴住好唔舒服。
你戴住會似個傻瓜 😂
不過起碼有啲成分，例如視黃醇，只係我冇感覺到任何精華，所以唔知道佢有冇真正好處。

reviews.text: Tried this lifting patch and really liked the result. The high-tension fabric fits securely and stays in place, and after 30 minutes the jawline looks a bit more defined with reduced puffiness. The formula with caffeine, L-carnitine and retinol gives a nice firming and smoothing effect. A good quick fix before going out.
reviews.zh: 試咗呢款提拉貼片，效果好好。高張力布料貼得好穩，唔會跌落，30 分鐘之後下巴線睇落更加清晰，腫脹感都減咗。含咖啡因、左旋肉鹼同視黃醇嘅配方，有好好嘅緊緻同平滑效果。出門之前用一下，係一個好快捷嘅方法。

reviews.text: I’m not completely sure how well it works yet, but I wanted to share my first impressions. This is the first product I’ve tried from this brand. The design requires it to hook around the ears, and I found that part a bit uncomfortable. It feels too tight for me, which makes it hard to wear for long periods. I’m hoping it might loosen up over time, but for now it’s not as comfortable as I expected.
reviews.zh: 我而家未完全肯定佢效果點，但我想分享我嘅第一印象。呢個係我第一次試呢個品牌嘅產品。設計需要將貼片掛喺耳朵後面，我覺得嗰部分有啲唔舒服。我覺得太緊，所以好難長時間戴。我希望佢會慢慢鬆返，但而家嚟講，佢冇我想像中咁舒服。

reviews.text: I liked the hydrogel patch. It sits well on the face, but does not pull the face up because the holes for the ears are stretched - so I secured them with a hair clip and got the effect I wanted - so that the mask would pull more.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意呢款水凝膠貼片。貼喺面上好服貼，但係因為耳位嘅孔被拉大咗，所以唔會將面拉上去——我用髮夾將佢哋固定，成功得到我想要嘅效果，令面膜拉得更加緊。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
